env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

logos build -o $WORK/good$GOEXE ./good
! logos build -o $WORK/mention$GOEXE ./mention
stderr -count=1 'correctness::result_before_error_check'
! stderr 'slop::'
! logos build -o $WORK/read$GOEXE ./read
stderr -count=1 'correctness::result_before_error_check'
! stderr 'slop::'
logos build -o $WORK/forward$GOEXE ./forward

-- go.mod --
module example.com/resultmention

go 1.27

-- mention/main.lgo --
package main

func fetch() (int, error) { return 7, nil }

func probe() (int, error) {
	n, err := fetch(); println(err, n); return n, err
}

func main() {
	_, err := probe()
	if err != nil {
		println(err)
		return
	}
}

-- read/main.lgo --
package main

func fetch() (int, error) { return 7, nil }

func probe() (int, error) {
	n, err := fetch()
	println(n)
	return n, err
}

func main() {
	_, err := probe()
	if err != nil {
		println(err)
		return
	}
}

-- good/main.lgo --
package main

func fetch() (int, error) { return 7, nil }

func probe() (int, error) {
	n, err := fetch()
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	println(err, n)
	return n, err
}

func main() {
	_, err := probe()
	if err != nil {
		println(err)
		return
	}
}

-- forward/main.lgo --
package main

func fetch() (int, error) { return 7, nil }

func probe() (int, error) {
	n, err := fetch()
	return n, err
}

func main() {
	_, err := probe()
	if err != nil {
		println(err)
		return
	}
}
